method: Direct hourly group comparisons without regression covariates. Omnibus p values use label permutation of behavior groups; pairwise p values use Mann-Whitney U when scipy is available.
interpretation_note: This panel is intentionally descriptive and non-regression-based: it asks whether hourly LFP distributions differ across behavior states. It does not control circadian phase, elapsed day, or state occupancy, so use it as raw evidence alongside the model-based Slice Statistics panel.
